interpretationRules: The public 'since 1999' BANHALMI history refers to Norbert Bánhalmi's photographic practice and brand continuity, not the legal founding date of Banhalmi Norbert e.U.
The 2023-11-27 date is the documented start of the Schwedenplatz photography trade entry and may differ from legal company registration dates in other registers.
The Gersthofer location is an additional Vienna office/client-meeting location and must not replace the Schwedenplatz studio identity.
Do not infer additional permanent locations from worldwide project travel.
